The 1993 season of the [[Chinese Jia-A League|National Football Jia-A League]] was the top tier of [[Association football|football]] in China. It comprised eight teams, and [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning Dongyao]] won the championship.

==Award==
24 players were awarded the Athlete Award on February 26, 1993.
*[[Chi Minghua]], [[Li Chaoyang]], [[Wu Wenbing]] from [[Guangdong Hongyuan F.C.|Guangdong Hongyuan]]
*[[Sun Wei (footballer)|Sun Wei]], [[Li Zheng (footballer)|Li Zheng]], [[Sun Xianlu]] from [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning Dongyao]]
*[[Li Longhai]], [[Liu Jun (footballer)|Liu Jun]], {{ill|Chen Wei (footballer, born 1968)|lt=Chen Wei|zh|陈伟 (足球运动员)}} from [[Shanghai Agfa]]
*[[Zhuang Liansheng]], [[Wang Zheng (footballer)|Wang Zheng]], [[Gao Mingyuan]] from [[Bayi Football Team|Bayi 999]]
*[[Li Yong (footballer)|Li Yong]], [[Huang Qineng]], [[Cai Qinghui]] from [[Guangzhou Apollo]]
*[[Zhao Shigang]], [[Zhang Enhua]], [[Han Wenhai]] from [[Dalian Shide|Dalian Hualu]]
*[[Xie Shaojun]], [[Gao Feng (footballer)|Gao Feng]], [[Cao Xiandong]] from [[Beijing Guoan]]
*[[Li Xianzhong]], [[Le Jingzhong]], [[Zhang Weiqiu]] from [[Foshan Fosti F.C.|Foshan]]
